branded.why: The sterilised milk of Southeast Asia, drunk and cooked with across the region for generations.

about.text: A sterilised milk from Nestlé Philippines, sold ready-to-drink in cans and cartons and as a powdered milk. A fortified Gold version exists, and it is sold across much of Southeast and East Asia.

sources.text: The Wikipedia article on Nestlé Bear Brand: its forms, producer and sales area.
